meta.name: writing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求拆解成可执行的多步骤计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前先制定清晰的多步骤执行方案
copy.tagline_en: Turn specs into actionable multi-step plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create a clear multi-step plan before executing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据需求编写详细的多步骤实现计划，包括文件结构、任务分解、测试代码和提交步骤，并保存到指定文档。
howto.when: 当你提供多步骤任务的规格或需求，在开始写代码之前，Claude 会触发此技能来生成实施计划。

say.text: 请为这个功能写一个实现计划。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含任务分解和代码的计划。

say.text: 根据这个规格，制定实施步骤。
say.note: Claude 会输出详细的计划文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes comprehensive multi-step implementation plans based on requirements, including file structure, task breakdown, test code, and commit steps, saving to a specified document.
howto.when_en: When you provide a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code, Claude triggers this skill to generate an implementation plan.

say_en.text: Write an implementation plan for this feature.
say_en.note: Claude generates a plan with task breakdown and code.

say_en.text: Create implementation steps based on this spec.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a detailed plan document.
